entries.description: Agent Skill that explains what Burrows Applications builds (native Android and iOS apps, Kotlin Multiplatform, and websites) and how to send the company a project inquiry.
representativeQueries: how do I contact Burrows Applications about building a mobile app
who can build a Kotlin Multiplatform app for Android and iOS
send a project inquiry to Burrows Applications

entries.description: Read-only MCP server with facts about Burrows Applications: company profile, services, and how to get in touch.
representativeQueries: list the services Burrows Applications offers
how can I get in touch with Burrows Applications

entries.description: Read-only JSON API with the company profile, services, and a status endpoint, described with OpenAPI 3.1.
representativeQueries: get the Burrows Applications company profile as JSON
which platforms does Burrows Applications develop for

entries.description: Read-only A2A agent (JSON-RPC, protocol 1.0) that answers with facts about Burrows Applications: company profile, services, and how to get in touch.
representativeQueries: ask the Burrows Applications agent what it builds
agent-to-agent contact details for Burrows Applications
